# Jonathan Au — Product Strategy & AI

> Personal portfolio of Jonathan Au, featuring his career in product strategy, applied AI/ML, AI search optimization, and building exceptional customer experiences.

## About

Jonathan Au has spent two decades transforming complex technical problems into products people enjoy. From designing touch-responsive animations for Microsoft's first tablet OS to turning living rooms into multiplayer arcades with nothing but a TV and a few phones, the thread through his career is making sophisticated technology feel simple for customers.

At Amazon, he creates gaming experiences that are fun, engaging, and effortless to dive into, removing the barriers that keep people from playing together. Before that, he owned personalization and engagement for Prime Gaming, shipping recommendation engines and A/B-tested features that measurably moved retention and conversion.

He is currently investing in applied AI/ML, with recent certifications in deep learning, RAG, and generative AI from Stanford, DeepLearning.AI, and AWS.

### Skills

- Product Strategy
- Generative AI
- Machine Learning
- Cross-functional Leadership
- Data-driven Decisions

## Experience

- Description: Led API strategy initiatives, helping shape the platform's developer-facing surface and integration capabilities across enterprise products.

- Description: Drove microservice modernization and booking conversion optimization, applying technical depth to improve the traveler experience at scale.

- Description: Built and shipped seamless streaming experiences for living room devices, turning TVs into intuitive entertainment hubs.

### Microsoft
- Role: Windows Platform & UX
- Description: Designed touch-responsive animations for Microsoft's first tablet OS. Contributed to the Windows platform, building a broad technical foundation in consumer-facing product engineering.

## Selected Projects

### Lumenyl AI Search Intelligence
- Category: AI Search Intelligence
- URL: https://lumenyl.vercel.app/
- Repository: https://github.com/jonathanau/ai-search-optimizer
- Description: A dependency-free Node.js web app for benchmarking a website's readiness for frontier AI answer engines. Lumenyl evaluates whether systems such as ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini / Google AI Overviews, and Microsoft Copilot can discover, understand, trust, extract, and cite a page.
- Technologies: Node.js, GEO / AEO, Schema.org, AI Readiness

### Two-Tower Video Recommender
- Category: Machine Learning / AI
- URL: https://github.com/jonathanau/two-tower-video-recsys
- Description: A minimalist, research-oriented PyTorch implementation of a two-tower retrieval model for video recommendations. Features sequential user modeling via Transformer encoders, MovieLens genre embeddings, and ANN retrieval using HNSW for fast top-k recommendation.
- Technologies: PyTorch, Transformers, HNSW, MovieLens

### PM Project Brain
- Category: AI Productivity Tools
- URL: https://github.com/jonathanau/pm-project-brain
- Description: An open-source, reusable prompt framework that helps product managers establish a persistent "project brain" for AI coding assistants. Streamlines context loading across tools like Claude, Copilot, Cursor, and Antigravity.
- Technologies: Prompt Engineering, Product Strategy, Developer Setup

### Mobile-Optimized Snake
- Category: Web Application
- URL: https://thesnakegame.onrender.com/
- Description: A fully responsive, touch-friendly modern implementation of the classic Snake game. Engineered specifically for seamless play on mobile devices as well as desktop browsers with an intuitive control scheme.
- Technologies: JavaScript, HTML5 Canvas, CSS3, Mobile UI/UX

### MDPreview
- Category: Developer Tools
- URL: https://mdpreview.onrender.com/
- Repository: https://github.com/jonathanau/mdpreview
- Description: A minimal, distraction-free Markdown editor built for the kinds of writing that feed AI systems: system prompts, agent instructions, RAG source documents, and project context files. Runs entirely in the browser with no server or account required, and documents persist locally via IndexedDB. Features a CodeMirror 6 split-pane editor, 8 color themes, multi-document management, and export to .md or rendered HTML.
- Technologies: Markdown, JavaScript, CodeMirror 6, IndexedDB, Vite

### Neovim Configuration
- Category: Dev Environment
- Repository: https://github.com/jonathanau/neovim-config
- Description: A modern, Lua-based Neovim setup with a lineage tracing back to my vimrc from 2005. Built around lazy.nvim for plugin management, Mason for automatic LSP installation, Telescope for fuzzy finding, and Treesitter for syntax highlighting. Includes a Ghostty integration that wraps Neovim as a native macOS app, launchable directly from Spotlight.
- Technologies: Lua, Neovim, LSP, lazy.nvim

### Global Infectious Diseases

- Category: Data Visualization
- URL: https://infectious-diseases.onrender.com/
- Repository: https://github.com/jonathanau/global-infections
- Description: A zero-dependency, single-page interactive infographic hub visualizing the global burden of infectious diseases. Covers 10 disease deep dives, DALY rankings, co-infection interactions, transmission routes, and seasonal patterns using data from WHO, CDC, and IHME.
- Technologies: JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Data Visualization, Public Health
